details.description: DeepSeek-R1-0528 is a May 28, 2025 update to DeepSeek AI's R1 reasoning model, released as an in-place improvement of the same 671-billion-parameter (37B active) Mixture-of-Experts architecture rather than a new model line, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card. DeepSeek attributes the update to increased post-training compute and algorithmic optimizations that deepen the model's chain-of-thought before answering, using roughly double the tokens per question versus the original R1. Unlike the original R1, DeepSeek's documentation states R1-0528 supports system prompts and no longer requires forcing the reasoning tag to start generation, and adds improved function calling. A related distilled 8-billion-parameter variant, DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, is also available. DeepSeek's changelog shows the deepseek-reasoner alias that served this model was reassigned to DeepSeek-V3.1 in August 2025, then to several later V3.x releases and finally to V4-Flash; DeepSeek's current API pricing page no longer lists deepseek-reasoner at all, following its announced 2026-07-24 discontinuation.
advantages: Scores 91.4% on AIME 2024 (pass@1), up from 79.8% for the original R1, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Scores 87.5% on AIME 2025 (pass@1), up from 70.0% for the original R1, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Scores 81.0% on GPQA Diamond, up from 71.5% for the original R1, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Scores 73.3% on LiveCodeBench, up from 63.5% for the original R1, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Scores 57.6% on SWE-bench Verified, up from 49.2% for the original R1, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Supports system prompts and improved function calling, unlike the original R1, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: Uses roughly double the tokens per answer versus the original R1 (about 23K vs 12K average on AIME), reflecting deeper but costlier reasoning, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.

DeepSeek's current API pricing page no longer lists this model; the deepseek-reasoner alias that served it was reassigned to DeepSeek-V3.1 in August 2025 and, after several further upgrades, ultimately to V4-generation models, before the alias itself was discontinued by 2026-07-24.
Text only; no image or audio input or output.
use_cases: Agentic use cases needing function/tool calling, newly supported in this update.

notes: Catalog's max_output_tokens (131072/160000) far exceed DeepSeek's own stated maximum generation length of 64,000 tokens for this model; kept catalog's values per instructions since facts are authoritative, but flagging the conflict here. Catalog's max_input_tokens (131072/160000) are broadly consistent with Fireworks' stated ~163.8K-token context for this model. No 'deepseek' (first-party) provider is listed for this model in Bud's catalog, only Fireworks and Hyperbolic, consistent with DeepSeek's own docs: the deepseek-reasoner alias moved on to DeepSeek-V3.1 as early as 2025-08-21 (well before any V4 model existed) and was itself discontinued by 2026-07-24.
